{{Quote|Captain, this is Sergeant Tong. I took the liberty of calling his transport team in to get these captured enemy weapons crated and moved.|Tanno Vik|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tong''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he and his team were called to the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] to transport a cache of enemy weapons recovered from [[Hazard Vault 451]] by [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Tong appears as part of the Trooper class mission "Den of Thieves" on Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
